question: Should OpenClaw add native per-task model hints to HEARTBEAT.md, fold this into a broader scheduled-run model override contract, or keep heartbeat model routing whole-turn/plugin-owned?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the fix changes public task syntax, model/provider precedence, session-state behavior, and the boundary between core heartbeat scheduling and plugin-owned routing.

options.title: Fold Into Scheduled Routing
options.body: Use one generic scheduled-run model selection contract so heartbeat tasks and cron jobs do not grow competing provider/model semantics.

options.title: Add HEARTBEAT.md Task Hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields in task blocks, split due tasks by effective model, and cover timestamp/session behavior in tests and docs.

options.title: Keep Whole-Turn Routing
options.body: Document before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins as the supported routing path and accept that one heartbeat turn uses one effective model.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Scheduled Routing
recommendation.body: Use one generic scheduled-run model selection contract so heartbeat tasks and cron jobs do not grow competing provider/model semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent overlap across heartbeat parsing/docs and plugin model-routing seams.
